public_gates: define matched L0/L2/L3 short-train configs with shared budget and seeds
preserve P0 no-wheel no-privileged actor contract
define evaluation surfaces without claiming private holdout evidence
do not run long training or promote a checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune one baseline separately
do not interpret smoke returns as evidence
do not promote a baseline checkpoint
hypothesis: A matched short-train config family for L0, L2, and L3 can be pre-registered with shared budget, seeds, and evaluation surfaces before running any trained-baseline comparison.
success_criteria: configs or config templates exist for L0, L2, and L3 short-train runs
all configs declare history_baseline_level and P0 actor contract
shared seeds and budgets are documented
the next executable milestone is a small matched short-train run
failure_criteria: configs use different budgets without justification
configs change actor inputs outside P0
design treats M526 public diagnostics as unbiased holdout

commands.name: matched_history_short_train_config_design
commands.command: Design the shared L0/L2/L3 short-train config family and next executable matched run.

decision_rule: M531 is a config-design gate. It should not run the matched comparison itself; it should admit the smallest executable matched short-train run only after shared recipes are explicit.
next_blocker: pending M531 matched history short-train config design
